note: LibreOffice application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for application commands (File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help) and their sub-items
LibreOffice toolbars -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for standard application controls (New, Open, Save, Print, Undo, Redo, formatting tools, etc.)
LibreOffice status bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for application status indicators (Ready, cell reference, zoom level, etc.)
Spreadsheet sheet tab list -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for sheet names (Sheet1, Sheet2, etc.) which are application-generated defaults
